messages.subject: validate() and need() with ggvis
parts:
Are there issues with using shiny's validate framework with ggvis?  Or is there some particular documentation about it that I haven't been able to locate?

I'm trying to port an app from ggplot2 to ggvis, and validate/need functionality that worked properly (its a very nice framework) no longer does so.

In particular, after one need() call fails, the other arguments in the same validation block will still be called, so I'll see errors for each need() call. 

In addition, propagation to the ggvis plots is.... odd.  If data is passed into ggvis as a reactive function rather than reactive data (i.e., myData instead of myData()), then sometimes shiny will crash and produce output to the console something like what's shown below.  On the other hand, if the ggvis call is wrapped in its own reactive statement and the data is passed as reactive data rather than a reactive function, then validation fails seem to have no effect at all.  The plots don't change, there's no user notification whatsoever.

Thanks,

Here's the console log:

observe({
    data_reactive <- data_table[[data_name]]
    session$sendCustomMessage("ggvis_data", list(plotId = id,
        name = data_name, value = as.vega(data_reactive(), data_name)))
})
